117993.name: Friendship Circle
117993.note: Detroit Jewish News, 4 July 2024, 'Since the Rebbe's Passing: over the past 30 years, these Chabad institutions have been founded in Michigan': 'Friendship Circle - 1994'. Also: 'the 8-year-old Friendship Circle' (Jewish News, Oct 2002). Its building: the Jewish News, Nov 24 2000, on the Lubavitch Foundation grounds in West Bloomfield, 'Rabbi Levi and Bassie Shemtov's Friendship Circle has unveiled plans for a learning and therapy center ... Ground will be broken this spring on the Meer' center, with the Ferber-Kaufman Life Town Center 'slated to open in 2002' (https://digital.bentley.umich.edu/djnews/djn.2000.11.24.001/37); it is now at 6892 W. Maple Rd. Before that it worked from West Bloomfield on W. Maple Rd. (a Jan 2000 listing; the number is unclear in the scan) as the 'Daniel Sobel Friendship Circle' (1995-98).
